shira/walk_hello.text: Hi! I'm Shira. Today we're heading out for a walk — at the right pace, with a clear head. Let's go!
shira/walk_hello.heard: Hi, I'm Shira. Today we're heading out for a walk at the right pace with a clear head. Let's go

shira/walk_warm.text: We start with an easy walk to warm up the body.
shira/walk_warm.heard: We start with an easy walk to warm up the body

shira/walk_stroll.text: Easy walk. Breathe, and let your shoulders drop.
shira/walk_stroll.heard: Easy walk. Breathe and let your shoulders drop

shira/walk_brisk.text: Brisk walk! Short, quick steps, and let your arms work.
shira/walk_brisk.heard: Brisk walk. Short, quick steps and let your arms work

shira/walk_power.text: Now power walk! As fast as you can — without running.
shira/walk_power.heard: Now power walk as fast as you can without running

shira/walk_last.text: Last power interval! Give it everything.
shira/walk_last.heard: Last power interval. Give it everything

shira/walk_cool.text: Slow down. An easy walk to finish.
shira/walk_cool.heard: Slow down. An easy walk to finish

shira/walk_half.text: Halfway there! Keep the same pace.
shira/walk_half.heard: Halfway there. Keep the same pace

shira/walk_form.text: Back tall, eyes forward, arms swinging by your sides.
shira/walk_form.heard: Back tall, eyes forward, arms swinging by your sides

shira/walk_talk.text: A good pace is one where you can talk, but not sing.
shira/walk_talk.heard: A good pace is one where you can talk but not sing
